intro: The Tainted Tablet is a starter quest in the Valley of Trials that directs aspiring spellcasters to Nartok inside the Den. It introduces the pragmatic yet cautious mindset of Durotar's warlocks, who seek to harness the Nether to forge their own destiny despite the lingering stigma of their past.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, friend.

I usually avoid dealing with adventurers if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, you received my message. Excellent. We orcs have a long and turbulent history with the entities of the Nether, but now we forge our own path, in command of our destiny. You, too, can seize the power to shape the future for your people. Where our leaders falter, we are ready to press forward and claim our rightful place. You will be of eminence among the travelers.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have just glimpsed the power that can be yours. The feeble and foolish among us are afraid of the path that we tread, but with boldness and cunning we can decide our own fates.
Guard your powers closely. The fearful lash out against that which they do not understand.
Now you are one of us. If you need training in spells then return to me.
